scope: Research-only additional broad land-vehicle packs. No Workshop subscriptions, purchases, server edits, or native DayZ tests were performed.
recommendation: Stage the official RaG, MaharlikaPH, and 4KBOSSK packs as candidates. Enable only after installed configuration and serverfile evidence passes validation; none has Azimuth wrap verification yet.

candidates.title: RaG_Vehicle_Pack
compatibility_evidence: Publisher changelog dated 2026-10-19 lists DayZ 1.30 fixes.
Publisher declares Expansion keys/keychains and Hunterz CarCover compatibility.
2025-06-28 changelog adds Survivor Animations support specifically for the ATV.

dependencies.status: No Required Items block exposed by the retrieved publisher page. Exact dependencies must come from installed CfgPatches.requiredAddons; absence of a page block is not dependency verification.

serverfiles.evidence: 2025-06-28 changelog says types updated for olive ZIL130.
serverfiles.gate: Read current installed publisher types and config. Exclude the static/editor vehicle variants the publisher added in 2024.

retexture.gate: Inspect exact body and detachable-panel hiddenSelections and texture/material paths; verify in-game readback before marking supported.

candidates.access: Public Workshop download; no paid access requirement shown.
candidates.license_summary: No repack or reupload. Approved monetized servers may use it if the mod itself is not monetized. Fetch original via Steam; do not bundle publisher PBOs in Azimuth ZIP.

candidates.title: MaharlikaPH_Cars
candidates.notable_features: Publisher describes functional taps, stoves and fridges on some vehicles; Modern Motorhome also has a washer.
compatibility_evidence: Publisher changelog dated 2026-10-15 lists DayZ 1.30 fixes.
2026-06-05 changelog fixes Cybertruck compatibility with DayZ-Expansion-Vehicles.
2026-10-16 fixes include binarized RVMATs, horns, secondary exhausts, and Modern Motorhome TV.

dependencies.status: No Required Items block exposed. Check installed CfgPatches.requiredAddons.
dependencies.optional_compatibility_note: Publisher's Modern Motorhome override is for MuchCarKeys. Do not add it to an Expansion-key setup without an actual MuchCarKeys dependency.

serverfiles.evidence: Description states keys and types.xml are included.
serverfiles.gate: Extract current publisher types and config; use map-appropriate event positions rather than assuming Workshop vehicles automatically enter Avalon economy.

retexture.evidence: 2026-04-03 changelog explicitly adds hiddenSelectionsTextures for retexturing those three families; 2026-04-04 fixes door retexture.
retexture.gate: Obtain exact selections and UV/materials; do not extend the three-family statement to all six without inspection.

candidates.access: Public Workshop download; no paid access requirement shown.
candidates.license_summary: No repack/reupload, including PBOs in server or map packs. Approved monetized-server use permitted. Fetch original via Steam.

candidates.title: 4KBOSSKVehiclePackage
candidates.count_caveat: The publisher page still says 29 vehicles but its displayed list has additional entries. Use installed class inventory for an authoritative count.
compatibility_evidence: 2026-10-15 publisher changelog states 1.30 support with possible remaining issues.
That update consolidates ModItemRegisterCallbacks to avoid stack overflow, fixes Kamaz LOD and adds motorhome door geometry.
2026-11-07 publisher changelog fixes additional vehicle LOD issues.

dependencies.status: No Required Items block exposed. Verify installed CfgPatches.requiredAddons.

serverfiles.gate: Discussion links a community-maintained mirror of claimed Discord types. Compare to current installed publisher configs; do not treat the mirror as verified current publisher data.

retexture.gate: Current exact body/door slots and material behavior still need installed-config evidence and native readback. Plate customization is not proof of full-body wrap support.

candidates.access: Public Workshop download; no paid access requirement shown.
candidates.license_summary: Repacking allowed but redistribution restricted to Steam Workshop. Use original Steam item; no publisher PBOs in an externally distributed Azimuth ZIP.

avoid_or_hold.title: 4KBOSSKVehicles
avoid_or_hold.decision: Avoid alongside official 3387855369. This separate older item advertises a 1.30 CarFix workaround and outdated types; duplicate model/class content risks conflict.

avoid_or_hold.title: cars_pack_by_bks
avoid_or_hold.decision: Avoid alongside official 4KBOSSK pack. Derivative subset adds no unique families beyond Bronco, Crown Victoria, Suburban.

avoid_or_hold.title: WickedRV
avoid_or_hold.decision: Hold: last publisher update observed 2022-11-18, Clothing Inventory Fix dependency, no verified 1.30 update. MaharlikaPH provides stronger current RV evidence.

shared_enablement_gates: Confirm Steam download finished and verify exact current Workshop item and PBO metadata without copying restricted third-party assets into Azimuth release.
Read actual CfgPatches dependency graph, script inheritance, CfgVehicles scope, drivable status, attachments, damage/texture slots, and publisher serverfiles.
Exclude static/editor versions, duplicate classnames, and incompatible parallel vehicle packs.
Validate events/types/cfgspawnabletypes plus safe Avalon positions and required parts/fuel; subscription alone does not create world spawns.
Assign server wrap ID, verify matching client ID, and read back each selected body/door texture/material after streaming, door changes, damage and restart.
Native DayZ join/start, drive, board/exit, save/restart and wrap tests remain required. No native tests were performed for these candidates.
unknowns: No Avalon-specific conflict has been confirmed or ruled out for these new packs.
No exact current drivable classname or complete requiredAddons set was verified from installed publisher content.
No candidate is guaranteed flawless with the complete existing Azimuth stack.
retrieval_note: Steam's parsed pages exposed generic removal/incompatibility/sign-in/subscription boilerplate on all retrieved items; those boilerplate strings are not used as availability, incompatibility, or subscription evidence. No subscription action occurred.
